title: queue: drain_once Err(_) on env read silently falls back without warning on non-NotFound errors
description: Line 219 queue.rs: Err(_) arm for .env read failure falls back to default injection source for ALL error kinds, including PermissionDenied. Only ErrorKind::NotFound should silently default (expected for legacy files). Other errors should warn! before falling back. Current code: 'Err(_) => stoa_core::default_injection_source()'. Should be: Err(e) if NotFound → default; Err(e) → warn! + default.
